title: [SYNTHETIC] US Pet Furniture: Easier Assembly
category: pet furniture and dog crate furniture
target_segment: Adults comparing furniture-style indoor dog crates
problem_statement: Investigate whether lower assembly friction, compact shipping or modular panels could differentiate a new concept. This is a research hypothesis, not a proven market problem.
goals: Find evidence-backed review themes without inventing prevalence
Compare at least two differentiated product concepts
Develop a proposed ProductSpec and risks
Create a labeled internal concept visual using Mock CreativeEngine
Produce an internal-only draft LaunchPack and identify sample verification gaps

must_preserve: No unverified safety, load rating or size claims
